issue.title: Fix #5213, set boolean options in config file.

repository.name: webpack
repository.description: A bundler for javascript and friends. Packs many modules into a few bundled assets. Code Splitting allows for loading parts of the application on demand. Through "loaders", modules can be CommonJs, AMD, ES6 modules, CSS, Images, JSON, Coffeescript, LESS, ... and your custom stuff.

issue.body:
**Kind of change**
Bugfix
**Related**
fix #5213
**More information**
When set any `boolean option` in webpack config file (like: `profile`, `cache` ,`bail`, v.v... ), it's broken.
After this PR, all will work usual.

body: @pierreneter The entire point of this issue is that I shouldn't have to use `--profile` in the CLI, since I set `profile: true` in the webpack config.
I saw. Im trying fix it.
Great! Works now with PR #5300 (just tested it). Thanks @sokra!
